_note: Rep 8 HR Overview: the neutral validated palette kept (calm people report, BRD section 7). Leavers and turnover use red only with a sign or arrow; teal = current period and improvements, slateLight = last year.

colors._note: Neutral default (from Rep 5): slate-teal primary, teal for the current period and improvements, red for declines, slate as the neutral accent. All text pairs are 4.5:1 or better on card and background; teal and slate/slateLight are for marks only. primary/accent/warning/good/bad/card/border/background/text/textMuted are the names gen_theme.py reads. /plan replaces this palette per rep.

polarity._note: Which way is an improvement, per base measure (brd.md section 4). Drives the Delta Colour display measures.

chart._note: Series order for the theme's dataColors, as names from colors. Red last: it means 'bad' on this report (leavers, above the company rate), so default categorical series (gender) never get it (Rep 8 wireframe).

fontPt._note: Power BI sizes in points: font px x 0.75, halves round up; caption raised from 9 to 10 for legibility (Rep 1). kpiSub: the KPI cards' reference line (LY and change), raised from caption 10 to 12 at the Rep 8 review.

pbiShadow._note: Power BI draws the CSS shadow darker (Rep 3), so visuals use this lighter mapping; preset Custom on every shadow.

container._note: Cards with a title and subtitle use paddingTop 14 (sides and bottom 20), so the title sits higher and the chart gets the space.

control._note: Slicers and buttons (px), pill-shaped (radius = half height). Button slicers under ~40px need padding.default Custom 0 top/bottom (CLAUDE.md). Dropdowns with a header need 76px (known-gaps).

tags._note: Wireframe tags (press T): what each visual is built with. native = Power BI visual and settings; svg = DAX measure returning an SVG image (ImageUrl) shown in a native card or table; html = HTML Content custom visual fed by a DAX measure.

heat._note: Matrix turnover gradient: dark text (colors.text) on every cell, darkest stop still 4.5:1.

table._note: Shared style for every table and matrix (gen_theme.py writes it to tableEx and pivotTable): muted semibold caption headers with a bottom rule, body-size values, horizontal rules only, white rows, no word wrap. Rep 8 review: the matrix and the at-a-glance table now match the department and job role table.
